title: Symplectic dynamics via a tube construction
summary: This is the first in a series of papers studying symplectic dynamics on Liouville domains $(W, λ)$ from a geometric approach. We employ Usher's tube construction to build a higher-dimensional Liouville domain from $(W,λ; H)$, where $H$ is a Hamiltonian function on $(W, λ)$, possibly non-autonomous. We establish dynamical stabilities with respect to a new Thompson-type pseudo-metric on Hamiltonians, bounded below by Banach--Mazur type distances.
